content.text: Route note — 2026 update: this is B0aty's HCIM Guide V3 updated for Sailing and Quest Month (November 2026); the combat tutors are gone, so Mudfoot's Big Adventure now gives your first weapons, runes and 2,000 combat XP.
All Settings -> Disable level-up
Talk to the Cook in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen and start Cook's Assistant (keep the Pot and Bucket from Tutorial Island)
Talk to Captain Harlan outside the General Store north of the castle and start Mudfoot's Big Adventure (1)
Talk to Cassius by the pond south of the windmill and start The Ides of Milk
Cross the River Lum and talk to Gillie Groats in the cow field just north of the gate [The Ides of Milk]
Talk to Seth Groats in the farmhouse next to the chicken coop [The Ides of Milk]
Search the shelf on the south wall of the farmhouse for The Groats Principles [The Ides of Milk]
Take an Egg [Cook's Assistant]
Milk the Dairy cow in the cow field for a Bucket of milk [Cook's Assistant]
Talk to Mudfoot by the building south of the cow field, without a pet following you [Mudfoot's Big Adventure]
Confront the outlaw walking outside the Lumbridge General Store [Mudfoot's Big Adventure]
Talk to Mudfoot again at the chicken field south of the Lumbridge windmill [Mudfoot's Big Adventure]
Kill the Ranger Outlaw (level 6) with the Bronze dagger on stab and take his Shortbow & 80 Bronze arrows [Mudfoot's Big Adventure]
Talk to Cassius to hand over The Groats Principles and get a Milk sample [The Ides of Milk]
Drink the Milk sample (1 damage, no poison) and talk to Cassius again for a new Milk sample [The Ides of Milk]
Pick Grain next to the windmill, put it in the hopper on the top floor and pull the lever [Cook's Assistant]
Use the Pot on the flour bin on the ground floor for a Pot of flour [Cook's Assistant]
Wield the Shortbow and kill the Mage Outlaw south of the H.A.M. Hideout, then take his Staff, Air runes & Mind runes [Mudfoot's Big Adventure]
Wield the Staff and go to the Lumbridge graveyard behind the church; if you left the fight area, fetch Mudfoot from outside the H.A.M. Hideout first
Kill the Warrior Outlaw with Wind Strike, because he prays Protect from Melee after your first hit, and take his Iron scimitar & Iron kiteshield [Mudfoot's Big Adventure]
Talk to Father Aereck in the church and start The Restless Ghost
Talk to Captain Harlan (1) and complete Mudfoot's Big Adventure
Use all 4 combat lamps from Mudfoot on Hitpoints
Sell the Bronze dagger, Bronze sword, Wooden shield & one Shortbow to the General Store and buy a Spade, Chisel & Hammer
Talk to the Cook and complete Cook's Assistant
Pickpocket a man/woman [Lumbridge Easy Diary]
Head East & Start X Marks the Spot on Veos (2,1) & complete the first step (Install Quest Helper plug in on Runelite)
Check playtime on Hans [Lumbridge Easy Diary]
Go upstairs and talk to Duke Horacio to start Rune Mysteries
Talk to Duke Horacio again and give him the Milk sample [The Ides of Milk]
Go upstairs again and Collect 4x logs on the top floor [Tree Gnome Village]
Bank at Lumbridge castle top floor and deposit all
Keep the Shrimps in your bank for later [Family Crest Quest]
Keep Mudfoot's Shortbow & all Bronze arrows in your bank for later [Underground Pass]
Move Coins into first bank slot & Runes to the top slots. Click the lock to Always set Placeholders. Set Bank pin for Count Check randoms or delete the pin from Tutorial Island.
Route note — Lumbridge, Wizards' Tower and Draynor loop: wear the leather gloves and boots; the goal is to collect quest items in one south-west loop, not to finish whole quests yet.
Withdraw: Coins, Air Runes, Mind Runes, Bread, Spade, Tinderbox, Air Talisman, Treasure Scroll (8 Inventory slots)
Go down south staircase twice (Right-Click 'Bottom-floor')
Collect the Empty Jug, Bowl & Knife in Lumbridge kitchen
Fill the jug & bowl on the sink in the kitchen [Monk's Friend]
Complete 2nd Step of X Marks The Spot
Kill a giant rat with Wind Strike and collect the Bones + Raw Rat Meat [Druidic Ritual]
Head West towards Draynor hugging the fence to avoid the Jail Guards
Talk to Father Urhney in the lumbridge swamp for Ghost Speak Amulet. (2,1) Wield this.
Take Leather Gloves on the table inside his house & wield
Head to the Wizards Tower
Take Leather Boots off the table & wield
Collect 3x Logs next to the stairs [Tree Gnome Village]
Head to the basement & Talk to Sedridor to continue Rune Mysteries (1,2,1)
Kill a Chicken. Take Everything (Make sure you get a feather, else hop worlds and repeat)[Client of Kourend + Druidic Ritual]
Collect 3x Logs [Tree Gnome Village]
Head north to Draynor & talk to Friendly Forester and obtain Forestry kit (right click shop and buy 1)
Bank at Draynor and Deposit all

Route note — Draynor, Port Sarim, Zeah, Lumbridge and the Stronghold: the Stronghold of Security is NOT a safe death, so bring extra food if your HP is low and leave when you run short of HP or run energy; it is fast early money, not a required HCIM step.
Withdraw: Coins, Spade, Feather & Mysterious Orb (4 Inventory Slots)
Collect Cheese from Aggie [Witch's House]
Complete 3rd Step of X Marks the Spot
Talk to Morgan and start Vampyre Slayer (1)
Go up the stairs and collect 4x Garlic from the cupboard
Train Draynor Agility to 5 Agility [Lumbridge Easy Diary]
Bank at Draynor and deposit the Garlic & Cheese
Talk to Fortunato & buy 5 Jugs of wine. Hop worlds and buy 10 in total.
Check the Notice board next to Fortunato to Start A Porcine of Interest
Complete 4th Step of X Marks the Spot
Head West to Port Sarim and talk to Veos to complete X Marks The Spot.
Destroy the lamp. You can collect this later as you can't bank it.
Travel to Port Piscarilius via Veos
Talk to Veos (4,1) [Client of Kourend]
Take the Minecart to Shayzien East (option B)
Open Minimap & follow the path South-West to Shayzien
Take the Beer
Use your Feather on the Enchanted scroll in your inventory
Head west to the General store, Talk to Jennifer_(Shayzien) for Client of Kourend (3,2)
Take the Tinderbox
Take Wizard Hat & Orange Dye [Shadow of the Storm, Goblin Diplomacy] from house to the west (Shayzien Styles)
Trade Robyn and buy a Chef's Hat [Cook's guild]
Home teleport to Lumbridge
Talk to Bob and buy a Steel Axe
Search the Coffin, south-east in the graveyard. Talk to Restless Ghost (1)
Talk to Count Check and choose the teleport to the Stronghold of Security (his dialogue was rewritten in November 2026)
Complete 3 Floors of Stronghold of Security. (Answer the questions or spam click doors)
On Floor 3, Spider max is 7 so if you take 3 or more damage, drink a wine before going through the door to avoid being stacked. Take the east doors.
Catablepon Max is 9 so drink on any damage.
Once you have 10,000GP from Floor 3, leave via the ropes
Collect 3x Beer inside the Longhall
Collect a Cooked Meat [Mournings End Pt 2]
Head east and Talk to Gertude (1) [Gertrudes Cat]
Collect a Doogle Leaf south of Gertrude
Bank at Varrock West Bank and deposit all

Route note — Varrock circuit with many quest starts: buy an air staff and combine Demon Slayer, Shield of Arrav, Gertrude's Cat, Children of the Sun, Priest in Peril and Daddy's Home; keep every quest item you make.
Withdraw: Coins, Bones, Beer (3 Inventory Spaces)
RIGHT CLICK Use the bones on the Stray Dog whenever you find him
Head East and buy an Air Staff from Zaff. Equip it.
Head South & Talk to Aris and start Demon Slayer (1,2,3,4).
Head South & Trade Thessalia [Varrock Easy Diary]
Buy Pink Skirt, Brown Apron & Silk. Wear Brown Apron & Pink Skirt in honour of Faux
Head South to the Sword Shop and go up the ladder. Loot the lit candle.
Head East and talk to Dr Harlow (1,2 talk again)[Vampyre Slayer]
Head North
Talk to Romeo (3,1) [Romeo & Juliet]
Buy a Newspaper from Benny(1,1)
Talk to Shilop to continue Gertrudes Cat (2,2)
Talk to Noah (1,3) [Children of the Sun]
Complete Children of the Sun
Go down North West 2x Stairs and talk to Sir Prysin in the SW room (3,1,2,2,1,1) [Demon Slayer]
Head North and go up 2x Stairs and talk to Captain Rovin (3,1,2,2,3,1) [Demon Slayer]
Return down the stairs and talk to Reldo and start Shield of Arrav (1,1).
Search for book and talk to Reldo again (1)
Head East and up the stairs in the Kitchen.
Collect both buckets and fill one up downstairs. Use Bucket of Water on drain outside then refill it.
Take the Pie Dish [Knight's Sword]
Head to King Roald and start Priest in Peril (1,1,3)
Talk to Marlo and start Daddy's Home (in a house the east of the castle) (2,3,3)
Pick up the Saw
Enter Varrock Sewer and take the North-West path to collect the Demon Slayer Key - Giant rat is aggressive, max hit is 1.
Enter Varrock Museum and head downstairs and talk to Orlando Smith (1) and complete the Natural History Quiz for 9 slayer and hunter and 28 kudos.
Bank at Varrock East bank and Deposit all
Route note — Varrock, Daddy's Home and materials: combine the Construction unlock, plank making, rune shopping and Varrock diary steps, and check your free inventory slots for logs and planks.
Withdraw: Coins, Saw, Hammer, Knife, Bronze Axe, Research Package, Tinderbox (7 Inventory Slots)
Talk to Aubury to continue Rune Mysteries (1,2)
Light both logs in the house right next to the rune shop.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo, then destroy all the furniture in the house (can't destroy furniture until you speak to him)
Talk to Old Man Yarlo to continue Daddy's Home (2)
Take 2x Logs & 2x ashes after cutscene
Search crates for 3x Waxwood log
Bank the ashes
Head North-East to the Lumberyard
Cut the Dying tree [Varrock Easy Diary]
Collect the Logs & fletch 2,100 Arrowshafts (hop between 2 worlds)
Collect 11 Logs & make 10 into Planks. Make the 3 Waxwood Planks.
Buy 5x Bolts of Cloth & 100 Steel Nails
Return to Old Man Yarlo & continue Daddy's Home
Light 1 log & take the 1x log
Collect Ashes
Trade Aubury and buy 1x Fire/Air/Earth Pack, 2x Water Pack, 3x Mind Pack
Complete Daddy's home at Marlo (1)
Open the crate
Bank at Varrock East bank
Route note — Varlamore materials in one visit: the Hunter's Guild gives new quest items and an early sellable resource; prices and stock can change.
Travel east to Regulus Cento & travel to Varlamore
Open the Minimap and Head South out of the City
Take the 3x Logs, Rope, Pestle & Mortar & Vial of Water
Head West and pick 2 Nettles [Ghost's Ahoy][Skippy & The Mogres]
Collect 1 Sweetcorn [Recipe for Disaster]
Head West to the Hunter's Guild
Collect the needle
Collect a Bucket of Water by the bank chest
Deposit all in the bank chest
Enter Guildmaster Apatura's building and go up both ladders
Loot 28 Eclipse Reds (hop worlds)
Deposit all.
Withdraw: Coins.
Collect a Bucket of Water by the bank chest
Head South-West to Sunset Coast. Be careful of the aggressive NPC's along the way as they can kill you if you do not pay attention.
Loot Fly Fishing Rod, Lobster Pot, 3x Iron Bar (hop worlds), Big Fishing Net & Feather
Travel with Antonia to Aldarin
Take Pot of Flour
Buy 6 Onions from the Food Store [Yellow Dyes]
Pick a Cabbage [Black Knight's Fortress]
Bank South and Deposit all
Withdraw: 28x Red Eclipse
Head West and trade Antonius and sell all 28 at once.
Head East after selling Eclipse reds and buy 3 Sunbeam ales from the Bartender in the pub. These give you a +1 agility boost to use the Taverley Dungeon shortcut later.

Head north-east to the Gem Store & buy 9x Uncut Sapphire, 10x Uncut Emerald, and as many Uncut Rubies as possible. (If the shop is out of stock, try to get a few or skip this step and mine a star after unlocking teleports to buy a Bag full of gems with stardust)
Head South to Mistrock & deposit all there
Buy Steel Pickaxe, 150 Wines, 20 mindbombs & 20 Stews (They are infinite stock so super fast to collect here)
Bank at Mistrock and deposit all.
Withdraw: Coins, Research Notes (2 inventory Slots) / Bronze pickaxe not needed
Home Teleport to Lumbridge
Head to the Wizards Tower
Take 3x Logs
Search the altar to collect the Ghost's skull. Run from the level 13 skeleton.
Complete Rune Mysteries
Teleport to Rune Essence Mine [Lumbridge Easy Diary]
Take 3x Logs
Head North to Draynor and Deposit all
Withdraw: Coins, Mind Runes, Small Fishing Net, Onion, Pickaxe, 454 Arrowshafts, 2x Wines (8 Inventory Slots)
Buy Chronicle & 10 Teleport cards from Diango
Use Pages on Chronicle and wield
Head West and talk to Redbeard Frank to start Pirate's Treasure (1,1)
Head South-West and buy a Harpoon, 50 Bait (non-packs) and 10 Feather packs. Take Apron from the wall & wear.
Make 454 Headless Arrows
Route note — Pandemonium (Sailing, November 2025) has no requirements; you need 2 free inventory slots and empty hands, and it unlocks Sailing, a raft and the Captain's log.
Unequip your weapon and the Chronicle, then talk to Will or Anne on the dock east of the Port Sarim Food Store to start Pandemonium
Complete Pandemonium (follow Quest Helper)
Wield the Chronicle again
OPTIONAL: once you have 4 Sailing, do one courier task between Port Sarim and The Pandemonium
Take Ship to Karamja (Seamen dressed in blue)
Talk to Luthas and ask for employment (1)
Fish Raw Shrimps [Karamja Easy Diary] Drop Shrimps
Pick 10 bananas
Buy Karamja Rum
Fill Crate with bananas and use Karamja rum on the crate
Make sure to speak to Luthas again before heading to the boat
Take boat back to Port Sarim [Karamja Easy Diary]
Trade Wydin and buy Raw Chicken, 2x Raw Beef, 3x Flour & 2x redberries
Continue Pirate's Treasure by talking to Wydin to get employed, and collect the rum from the crate.
Buy 8x Raw Sardines
Use the Deposit box by Entrana and deposit everything except: Mind Runes, Coins, 1x Raw Beef, Karamja Rum, Onion, Pickaxe & 2x wines (8 Inventory Slots)
Return to Redbeard Frank
Head West to Betty and buy 2x Eye of Newt & 200 mind runes
Head South-West and complete Witches Potion (Beef twice on range to burn)
Take 2x Logs when getting the rat tail
Buy moulds: Ring, Amulet, 2x Necklace, Bracelet, Sickle, Tiara, 3x Needle & 50 Thread (from Rommik in Rimmington)
Buy 3x Buckets & Shears
Head North-West and collect a Snape Grass
Milk the cow 3x by Crafting guild
Kill a cow & take everything
Shear a sheep by the Makeover Mage
Take Falador Crumbling wall Shortcut [Falador Easy Diary]
Bank at Falador West Bank and deposit all
Withdraw: Coins, Mind Runes, Raw Rat/Chicken/Beef, 10x Wines, Empty Bucket, Chest Key, Cheese (18 Inventory Slots)
Get a haircut North [Falador Easy Diary]
Fill Bucket on Pump [Falador Easy Diary]
Head South and talk to the Squire and start Knight's Sword (1,2,1,1)

Get a Mahogany Home Beginner Contract from Amy (try and do these whenever passing if viable (aka if Hosidius and you're nearby, detour and complete it. If not they're done later but may be inefficient) - Mahogany homes plugin or notepad to remember your tasks.
Kill a duck in Falador Park [Falador Easy Diary]
Buy 6x Woad Leaves from Wyson the Gardener (1,4)
Head North of Falador and kill a Black Bear (safespot on trees as it is a 2x2). Collect the Raw Bear Meat, Bones & fur.
Head to Taverley and talk to the boy to start Witches House (1,1)
Head North and talk to Kaqemeex to start Druidic Ritual (2,1)
Complete Witches House quest - Safespot guide for the spider: https://youtu.be/bDB351j-qZI?t=178
Keep the Door Key [Mournings End Pt 2]
Head South and buy 1x Vial of Water Pack
Talk with Sanfew upstairs.
Complete Druidic Ritual
Chronicle to Varrock
Go upstairs in Blue Moon inn and continue Pirate's Treasure
Talk to Baraek (3,1) [Shield of Arrav]
Talk to Reldo (2) [Knights Sword]
Bank at East Bank

Route note — Edgeville, Wilderness and Ardougne: HCIM WARNING, this segment uses the Wilderness and the lever, and a normal death to monsters or PKers costs your status; skip it if you want and do the diary and miniquest steps later.
Withdraw: Mind Runes, Coins, Raw Sardine, Doogle Leaves, Bucket of Milk, Snape Grass, Rope (7 Inventory Slots)
Head North East & continue Gertrude's Cat
Chronicle and complete Gertrude's Cat

Raise Kittens as much as you want. They will be worth 200 Death Runes later which is very useful. IF YOU ARE NOT DOING LMS/ SOUL WARS 1+1 OR EARLY REVENANTS FOR MONEY: IT IS RECOMMENDED TO RAISE CATS FOREVER. If you can collect a few Thousand Death Runes passively you can burst Zombie Axe much later & get a Barrows Portal before Barrows
Buy 2x Bronze Med Helm in Barbarian Village [Black Knights Fortress][Mournings End Pt 2][Kings Ransom]
Head to Edgeville
Here I would recommend Private off and hop to avoid being bagged up.
Talk to Mage of Zamorak in Wilderness [Enter the Abyss] <- The Miniquest
Go back to Edgeville and take the Lever to the Wilderness, then to Ardougne, then back to the Wilderness, and then back to Ardougne for the Wilderness & Ardougne Diary (use the lever 4 times)
Head to the Grand Tree
Complete Gnome Agility Course [Western Province Easy Diary]
Trade Heckel Funch or Hudo and buy Dwellberries, 2x Bucket of Milk, 2x Chocolate Dust [Plague City]
Return to Ardougne & complete Plague City
Read the Ardougne Teleport Scroll in your inventory
Start Biohazard until you get the samples
Take 1 extra Rotten Apple [Mournings End Pt 1]
Take 5 extra Pigeon Cages [One Small Favour]
Fill your inventory with Balls of wool when passing the general store
Check Probita for Pets [Ardougne Easy Diary]
Bank at Ardougne South Bank
Route note — Knight's Sword blurite: Ice Warriors can kill an early account quickly, so use a proven safespot, keep a teleport ready and never mine while you are taking damage.
Withdraw: Coins, Pie Dish, Pickaxe, 2x Iron Bars, 5x House Teleport Tablet, 1x Falador Teleport Tablet, 15 Wines, Bucket of Water, Biohazard Items (27 Inventory Slots)
Take the boat to Rimmington
Talk to the Chemist continue Biohazard (2)
Give Chancy the Honey, Da Vinci Ethenea & Hops Sulhpuric Broline
Head to Port Sarim
Trade Wydin and buy Flour and Redberries and make an Uncooked berry pie
Cook the pie North (If you burn this, just repeat the steps until you succeed)
WALK South to Thurgo and continue Knights Sword (2,1) (you want run energy for next step)
Head into Asgarnia dungeon (Chronicle is emergency teleport if you gargle)
Mine 2x Blurite Ore (Make sure to safe spot the Ice Warriors first. DO NOT TANK THEM WHILE MINING)
Teleport to Falador with Teletab
Continue Knights Sword
Use House teleport to return to Thurgo
Walk back to Falador after you get the sword.
Complete Knights Sword
Home teleport to Lumbridge
Head to Al Kharid
Start Prince Ali Rescue talking to Chancellor Hassan (1,1)
Take Jug of Water
Talk to Osman
Head to Shantay Pass
Deposit all
Route note — The Tourist Trap: the Mercenary Captain needs safe positioning, and the fastest safespot route is not automatically the best choice if you are inexperienced.
Withdraw: Coins, Mind Runes, 50 Feathers, Hammer, Knife (5 Inventory Slots)
Buy Desert Robes & wear them
Buy 10x Bronze Bars & 10x Ropes
Bank 7 Bronze Bars [keep 3 for Tourist Trap] & 10 Ropes
Buy 3x Buckets of Water & deposit
Withdraw 12 Wines
Buy 1x Waterskin (4) & 1 Shantay Pass
Start Tourist Trap
Take his bones [Demon Slayer]
Complete Tourist Trap
Use Rewards on Agility
Buy atleast 1x Bronze Bars [Mournings End Pt 2]
Bank at Shantay pass and deposit all
Withdraw: Coins
Minigame teleport to Last Man Standing/Clan Wars. Recharge Run Energy in the Free to Play portal by entering and leaving.
Return to Minigame teleport location and take the green portal east to Castle Wars
Head East to Yanille taking the south route to avoid Ogres
Buy a Greenmans Ale from the Bartender in Dragon Inn [Recipe for Disaster]
Trade Aleck [Ardougne Easy Diary] and buy Butterfly Net, 10x Buttefly Jar, 3x Bird Snare, 1x Teasing Stick, 8x Box Traps
Head North and take Jug of Water [Monk's Friend]
Buy 2x Rotten Tomato at Pelters' Veg Stall [Recipe for Disaster][Mournings End pt 2]
Bank at Yanille and Deposit all
Withdraw: Coins, Pickaxe (2 Inventory Spots)
Head to Port Khazard
Mine 10x Clay on the way
Buy 5x Pot of flour, 2x Swamp paste
Collect 2x Planks
Deposit all at Bank Chest
Withdraw: Coins (1 Inventory Spot)
Buy 100 Soda ash + 100 Buckets of sand, 1x Glassblowing pipe, 20x Pineapples (Can also buy at Catherby/Lands End later if stock is bad)
Deposit Inventory
Withdraw: Mind Runes, Coins, 1x Logs, Jug of Water, 5x Wines, (9 Inventory spots)
Collect 2 planks
Complete Fight Arena
Safe spot everything over the closest Corpse.
Complete Monks Friend
Collect Rat Poison beneath Clock Tower [Rat Catchers]
Activate Thick Skin prayer & Head North through the Ardy Zoo
Head North to the church then start Sheep Herder (1,1) Wear Plague outfit
Pray at Altar [Ardougne Easy Diary]
Buy Full Inventory of Balls of wool from the general store
Bank at Ardougne North bank. Deposit all.
Withdraw: 4x Wines, Poisoned Sheep feed (5 Inventory Slots)
Continue Sheep Herder until all 4 Sheep bones are burnt
Drop Poisoned Sheep feed, Plague robes & cattleprod once done.
Head North hugging the Fishing Guild to avoid Moss Giants
Start Dwarf Cannon up to needing to go to Falador
Head North to Barbarian Assault
Deposit all
Talk to Captain Cain & unlock Barbarian Assault teleport (Skip tutorial)
Start the Barcrawl by talking to the Barbarian guard (1,2)
Loot & Bank 139 Planks (1x 27 Inventory & 4x 28)
Withdraw: Mind Runes, Air Staff, Leather Gloves+Boots, Coins, 6x Logs, Rope, Barcrawl Card, 10x Wines (20 Inventory Spots)
Wield Air Staff, Gloves & Boots
Head south and start the Waterfall Quest by talking to Almera
Continue until you receive the Book on Baxtorian
Head South to East Ardougne
Head into the pub for the Barcrawl (Bartender (Flying Horse Inn))
Start Temple of Ikov by talking to Lucien (2,1)
Start Hazeel Cult [Side with Hazeel]
Collect 2x Purple Dye when passing [Goblin RFD][Song of the Elves]
Complete Hazeel Cult
Head to Tree Gnome Village
Collect Glarials Pebble [Waterfall Quest]
Complete Tree Gnome Village
Take the bones [Demon Slayer]
Take Spirit Tree to Gnome Stronghold (2) [Western Province Medium Diary]
Talk to King Narnode (1,1) [The Grand Tree]
Bank up the ladder
Withdraw: Barcrawl Card, Coins, Knife (3 Inventory Spots)
Trade Hudo North
Buy 1x Gnome Spice [Recipe for Disaster Goblin]
Trade Gnome Waiter
Buy Toad crunchies (Premade t'd crunch) [Mournings End Pt 1]
Head East
Talk to Blurberry and continue the Barcrawl
Trade Heckel Funch East of Blurberry
Buy 10x Pineapple, 2x orange, 3x Lemon, 1 Cocktail Shaker, Cocktail Glass
Cut the orange and lemon into slices [Recipe for Disaster]
Make a Fruit Blast by clicking cocktail shaker [Recipe for Disaster]
Buy 5 Buckets of Milk & 3 Vodka from Heckel Funch
Bank west and deposit all
Withdraw: House Teleport, Coins, Mind Runes, Rope, Bark sample, Barcrawl Card, Translation book, 10 Wine (17 Inventory Spaces)
Minigame teleport to Castle Wars
Head East to Yanille
Do the Barcrawl by talking to the Bartender in Dragon Inn Barcrawl step (4)
Talk to Hazelmere to continue Grand Tree
Right click your house tab and teleport to Outside House
Head west and take the boat to Brimhaven
Head to the Bar and complete the Bartender (Dead Man's Chest) Barcrawl (4)
Talk to Kangai Mau(2,1) in the Brimhaven food store [Tribal Totem]
Return to Ardougne via Captain Barnaby [Karamja Easy Diary]
Continue Tribal Totem up until and including talking to the GPDT employee
Bank at Ardougne South Bank
Withdraw: Coins, Silk
Sell Silk to the Silk merchant for 60 coins (3,2) [Ardougne Easy Diary]
Steal cakes until 6,099 Thieving Experience (Keep 20 Bread)
Teleport to Essence Mine via right click Wizard Cromperty [Ardougne Easy Diary]
Talk to Wizard Cromperty (2,2,1) [Tribal Totem]
Continue Tribal Totem
(WARNING: RIGHT CLICK INVESTIGATE STAIRS AFTER OPENING DOOR WITH CODE KURT)
Bank all Bread at South Bank
Complete Tribal Totem
Keep 1 Swordfish [Family Crest Quest]
Buy 15 Pineapples from Charter Ships
Take Boat to Ardougne & bank at the South Bank
Withdraw: 13x Soda Ash & 13x Bucket of sand
Complete Sheep Herder
Make 13 Molten Glass on Furnace West of Chapel [Observatory Quest]
Bank at Ardougne North Bank. Deposit everything
Withdraw: 10x Wines, Air Staff, Mind/6xAir/6xEarth/All Water Runes, Glarials Pebble, Rope (17 Inventory Slots)
Continue Waterfall Quest by obtaining Glarials Amulet and Urn from the Tomb (drop runes & staff). Tank skeleton hit and run past moss giants
Continue Waterfall Quest
Kill a Fire Giant inside Baxtorian Falls (use water spells)
Somebody will get Rune Scimitar on this kill. I hope that's you.
Complete Waterfall Quest
Minigame Teleport to Soul Wars
Leave portal to Edgeville
Withdraw: Coins, Mind Runes, Air Staff, Water Runes, Ghostspeak Amulet, Chronicle, Leather Gloves+Boots, Wizard Hat, Pink Skirt, 5x Wines (15 Inventory Slots)
Head East and take Grand Exchange Shortcut
Take Spirit Tree to Gnome Stronghold (2) [Varrock Medium Diary]
Continue Grand Tree
During Grand Tree, Kill Foreman and take bones [Demon Slayer]
Buy 15 Pineapples at the Shipyard
Charter to Brimhaven [Karamja Medium Diary]
Return to Ardougne & deposit the Pineapples & bones in the South Bank
Head West
Buy 8x Papyrus from General Store
Take Spirit Tree from Khazard Battlefield to Gnome Stronghold (2)
Continue The Grand Tree
When you go talk to Anita, take 2 Swamp toads [Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]
Drop Glough's Key after getting the Invasion Plans
Black Demon Safespot (Use Waterspells): https://youtu.be/D7wFjCCKRAU?si=NiUw7IwqlugmrGlu&t=23
Complete Grand Tree
Bank and deposit inventory
Withdraw: 20x Ball of Wool, Mind Runes, Ghosts Skull, 2x Wine (24 Inventory Slots)
Home teleport to Lumbridge
Complete Restless Ghost
Complete Sheep Shearer (1,1)
Kill a Zombie in Draynor Sewers. Take bones. [Lumbridge Easy Diary]
Bank at Draynor
Withdraw: 3x balls of wool, 1 bronze bar, Ashes, Coins, Clay, Pot of Flour, 2x Bucket of Water, 4x Onions, 6x Woad Leaves & 1x Redberries (16 Inventory Slots)
Make Soft Clay
Continue Prince Ali Rescue until you need to return to Osman
Make Dyes on Aggie (You will use these dyes later) (2 Yellow, 3 Blue, 1 Skin paste)
Take Cheese [Mournings End Pt 2]
Deposit All
Withdraw: barcrawl Card, Coins, Enchanted Scroll, Enchanted Quill (4 Inventory Slots)
Complete the Barcrawl at Port Sarim
Talk to Veos to reclaim your X Marks the Spot lamp and use it on Herblore
Head to Veos and travel to Port Piscarilius
OPTIONAL: Travel to Lands end if you haven't got your 100 Soda Ash/Sand
Head North to the Piscarillius General Store, talk to Leenz(3,2)
Head South then Directly East along the pier to reach the Food Store;
Buy Raw Sea Bass, Swordfish, 3x Cod & 15 Sardines while here for your Kitten
Head west to the Minecart and travel to Lovakengj
Bank the fish
Head East and slightly North to the General Store, talk to Munty (4,2)

All Tempoross (except Angler outfit)
ALL Scurrius
Barrows; (All but 10/25 KC tasks)
Deranged Archaeologist; (Magic only & dodging books) [GENUINELY BE CAREFUL ON THIS ONE. HE CAN HIT HARD]
Giant Mole; (No damage kill)
Hespori; (Hesporisn't, Weed Whacker, Plant-Based Diet)
Hueycoatl; (10kc, earth spells, Pillar Lover, Speed Trialist, Perfect Huey) [Can do on Mass world]
Jad Challenges; (Second Challenge + only melee) [This one is challenging so attempt for fun or skip]

Chambers of Xeric: (No Falling Rocks Guardians, Long Range safespot a Shaman, Ice demon with no prayer, damage & fire spells, Tightrope Skip) [Scout the first room. 2x Phoenix Necklace & tick perfect for Rope skip(also maybe a skip as challenging)
Entry TOB has some easy CAs otherwise the above is what I did. Medium before barrows IS NOT MANDATORY BUT IS COZY.
78 Magic -> Boost to 83 and make a Barrows portal in POH
Salve Graveyard portal (Home teleport, recharge prayer on altar/pool, take salve graveyard portal->BKR fairy ring->Boat to barrows)
^ Making Agility Potions to jump the wall is optional
Complete barrows until you have Tank helm, Plate, Legs
Herblore
Dump all your herblore experience. If 70 achieved, skip to completing Song of the Elves then return to this step
Make Super Strengths & equal amount of Super Attack
Minigame Teleport now takes you straight to Mastering Mixology
Use Harralanders, Avantoe & Irits in Mastering Mixology (Don't grind them all incase the ratios aren't correct. 10k+ is good then top up)
Complete the Grapple Diary steps and use all lamps on Herblore
Song of the Elves
Runite Bar - If crystal key open Crystal Chest in Taverley. If not/no luck, trade Rune Legs in at the Nest in Aldarin for guaranteed Runite Bar
Complete Song of the Elves
Make 10+ Phoenix Necklaces
Seren Video guide - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XRZVxU-umX8
Perilous Moons
Camp Perilous Moons until Eclipse & Blood (Green logging optional) [I don't recommend Birdhouse runs/Farm contracts while there]
(Step unders are very recommended until they start hitting 16s)
I recommend killing all 3 until 70 prayer is banked, then you can do 1kc runs if only 1 outstanding set
Zombie Axe Eclipse on Slash (Step under every hit)
Zombie Axe Blue Moon on Crush (Use the Boppers if you get them, step under every hit)
Zombie Axe Blood Moon on Slash (Use DDS specials for this one. Steps under only when you see the blood leave your character)
WHEN 60 PRAYER BANKED GET CHIVALRY WITH VARLAMORE PRAYER METHOD (Wave 1 colloseum for Sunfire Splinters)
Chivalry now drains as slowly as Deadeye and Mystic Vigour
IF 70 PRAYER BANKED GET PIETY WITH VARLAMORE PRAYER METHOD
While doing Perilous Moons you should hopefully bank and finish off 70 herblore if not already
Perilous Moons Loot:
Supercompost: Mine 2:1 Volcanic Ash:Compost and turn them into Ultra Compost
Dump all banked prayer experience
Water orbs: Make Battlestaffs & alch (You can alch the staffs while doing the next hunter staff and repeat the process)
Maple & Yew Seeds: FARM BROTHER

Withdraw: Teleport Runes, Death Rune, Axe, Defence Potion (3)/(4), Volcanic Sulphur, Molten Glass, Dark Essence Block, Kharedst’s Memoirs, games necklace, Pickaxe (13 Inventory Slots) + Combat Gear & Food
Teleport to Kourend Castle
Complete Kingdom Divided
Withdraw: Teleport Crystal, Ardy Cloak, Dramen Staff, Pickaxe, Coins, Axe, Knife, Teasing Stick, 3 Fox fur, Tick Manipulation & 5 box traps (19 Inventory Slots)
Teleport to Priffdinas
Head East & Mine an Adamantite Ore [Western Province Hard Diary]
Head north and catch around 5,000 Red Chinchompas
Ardy Cloak -> AJP
Head East towards the Sunlight Antelopes
Catch 3x Sunlight Antelopes (Keep the fur)
Ardy Cloak -> AJP
Head to Hunter Guild
Talk to Pellem and make Mixed Hide Top, Bottom & Boots
Bank at Hunter Guild
Withdraw: Coins, Butterfly net/Magic Net
Buy 27 Butterfly Jars from Imia North-East
Talk to Guildmaster Apatura (2,1) [At First Light]
Continue At First Light until needing to go to Guild Hunter Fox
Go down the stairs and catch Moonlight Moths to the South
Moonlight Moths restore 22 prayer per inventory slot and you can catch over 400/hour so these are excellent prayer
Use Dashing Kebbit meat on Moonlight Moths to double the restore to 44 per inventory slot (You can optional hunt more if you want)
Throw the Chinchompas to get 75+ Range
Kill Royal Titans until both Prayer Scrolls
Use all 3 Perilous Moons Sets
These are 0 damage if you use Water/Fire Wave on the Elementals and kill both giants roughly at the same time so very safe on HCIM
Once you have your Bow of Faerdhinen & optional Saeldor
Head to Fossil Island
Withdraw a Chisel & Uncut gems from Gauntlet.
Cut these Underwater while farming Seaweed Spores & Seaweed from the patches
Fletch Arrowshafts from Maple Logs 45-52 Fletching in similar style
Depending how spooned your Enhanced(s) were depends on how much outstanding Mining we will need to do later for crafting as we will want an amulet of glory fairly soon (75+5 boost/80)
Teleport to Miscellania and collect your resources (check allocation before to make sure they are atleast on x10 teaks)
Withdraw: Ardougne Cloak, Dramen Staff, Coins
Ardy Cloak -> AIS
Head North and bank, withdrawing 27 Teak Logs
Turn 27 Teak Logs into Planks at the Sawmill North-West. You will need roughly 8,000 Teak Planks for 83 Construction Banked
Buy 1x Bolt of Cloth
Minigame teleport to Blast Furnace
Depending on Coal/Iron in the bank, buy 300 coal+Iron & make 300 Steel Bars at the Blast Furnace
Withdraw: Coins, Teleport Runes to House, Falador, Varrock, Ardougne, Nature Runes, Noted Rune from Corrupted Gauntlet, 4x Steel Bars, Plank Sack, Inventory of Teak Planks
Alch your Rune & Dragon Items from Corrupted Gauntlet while training construction via Mahogany Homes until 83 Construction
Withdraw: Coins, Teleport Runes, Camulet, Ardougne Cloak, Dramen Staff,
Minigame Teleport to Blast Furnace
Head West & buy 11x Gold Leaves, 10x Marble Blocks, 15x Limestone Bricks, 1x Magic Stone
Teleport to Yanille
Buy 6,000 Soul Runes
Teleport to Falador
Make 3x Duelling Rings (8), 3x games necklace (8)
Ardy Cloak -> CIS
Talk to Tyss for Arceuss Signet
Ardy Cloak -> Zanaris
Buy a Fairy Enchantment from Fairy Fixit
Camulet
Talk to Eblis for an Ancient Signet
Bank anywhere

Withdraw: Bow of Faerdhinen & Crystal Armour, Teleport Runes, Tinderbox, Coins, Guam Leaf, Marrentil, Pestle & Mortar, Hammer, Costume Needle, Axe, Pickaxe, Spade, Sapphire Lantern (16 Inventory Spaces)
Ardy Cloak -> CIP
Take boat to Relleka
Talk to Brundt [Lunar Diplomacy]
Complete Lunar Diplomacy
Wield Seal of Passage
Bank at Lunar Bank (DO NOT DEPOSIT ALL ARMOUR SETS)
Withdraw: Bow of Faerdhinen & Crystal Armour, Seal of Passage, 3 lots of 7 random cooked food
Complete Dream Mentor. (Bosses are a breeze with Bow of Fardhinen. Safespot the 2nd & 3rd by the book)
Trade Baba Yaga & buy Lunar Signet & 11,000 Astrals Runes
qh-V2fg-I.png
Withdraw: Bow of Fardhinen & Crystal Armour, TINDERBOX, Sapphire Lantern, Food & Potions, Duelling Ring, Astral Runes, Water & earth Runes, Waterskin
Teleport to Emir’s Arena
Head South to Shantay Pass
Take Carpet to Polnivneach
Complete a lap of Pollnivneach Agility Course [Desert Hard Diary]
Take Carpet to Sophanem
Talk to High Priest [1,4] [Contact!]
Continue Contact until you pick up the Keris
Return to the maze & kill the ranger Locus Rider nearby [Desert Hard Diary]
Complete Contact!
Head to Nardah
Withdraw: 5x Mithril Bars, Tinderbox & 1x Yew Log
Light a fire on the Mayor’s Balcony [Desert Hard Diary]
Smith a Mithril Platebody [Desert Hard Diary]
Bank at Nardah
Withdraw: Blackjack, Noted Food, Coins, Rogues Outfit
Head to Pollnivneach and train thieving until 71 (Blackjack Bandits until 65 then Menaphites to 71)
OPTIONAL: with 50 Sailing, stall thieving in Port Roberts (gems, ores and cannonballs) is a calmer alternative without knock-outs
Take Carpet to Sophanem
Bank at Contact! bank
Withdraw: Food, Lockpick, Cure Me Spells
Go to Pyramid Plunder & Loot all Gold Chests until Room 6, and all Sarcophagus’ during & after Room 4 (6 Gold Chests, 3 Sacrophagus’)
Repeat until you find a Pharaoh’s Sceptre (Roughly 4 hours)
Use all Sceptre Charges so it is empty
If you spoon it, finish 72 Thieving off at either Menaphites or Pyramid Plunder (Looting Room 5 & 6 fully)
Withdraw: Coins, Teleport Runes, Hammer, Crystal Saw, 2x Mahogany planks, 3x Gold Leaf, 8x Marble Block, Bolt of Cloth, Steel Bar, 3x Duelling Ring (8), 3x games necklace (8)
Home Teleport to Lunar Isle
Swift back to Regular Spellbook
Teleport to Player Owned House
Use the building mode to move all the rooms away
Build a superior garden immediately North of the portal. (rotate for the pool to be close to portal)
Build an Achievement Gallery West of the portal. (rotate for the jewellery box to be close to portal)
Build/Move a Study East of the Portal
Build a portal nexus West of the superior garden
Build a Marble portal nexus. Upgrade it to Gilded portal nexus
It is your choice what teleports to put in this. I personally had Kourend Castle & Lunar Isle as musts, and the rest were the standard spellbook teleports. Kharyrll for Morytania Diary
Build a Mahogany EAGLE Lecturn in the Study
Build a Basic Jewellery Box in the Achievement Gallery
Bank at Castle Wars via your Jewellery box and withdraw: 10x Limestone Bricks, Magic Stone, 5000 Blood & Soul Runes, Arceuss Signet
Build a Dark Altar in the Achievement Gallery
Withdraw: Wily Cat, Stews, Pharaoh’s Sceptre, Ancient Signet, Lunar Signet, 10000 Astral Runes, Hammer, Crystal saw
Catch Rats and use Orange Spice to Boost Construction
If you get a +2 boost (85+), you can bank and make the Fairy Ring in the POH as you will have time
When you get a +5 boost (88), pick up your cat and teleport to POH and make the Occult Altar in the Achievement Gallery
Withdraw: Dramen Staff, Teleport Runes
Teleport to POH -> AJP
Head to Mastering Mixology and dump a good portion of your herbs here.

Use Harralanders, Avantoe(some Kwuarm) & Irits in Mastering Mixology (Don't grind them all incase the ratios aren't correct. 10k+ is good then top up). Don’t use all your Kwuarms as you will need them
Buy the goggles/Amulet if you haven’t already.
Withdraw: Dramen Staff, Teleport Runes, Coins, Brimhaven Vouchers
Teleport to Ardougne
Take the boat to Brimhaven
Buy Amylase packs from Pirate Jackie the Fruit
Boost if needed and make 10 Stamina Potions (4), 10 Super Restores (4), 10 Prayer Potions (4)
Bank all
Withdraw: Teleport Runes, Hammer, Crystal Saw, 5 Limestone Bricks, 5 Buckets of Water, 1,000 Soul Runes, 1,000 Body Runes, 10 Stamina Potions (4)
Teleport to POH
Make a Restoration Pool then upgrade it to a Revitalisation Pool
Teleport to Castle Wars via Jewellry Box
Withdraw: 10x Prayer Potions (4), 10x Super Restores (4) & 2x Marble Blocks
Teleport to POH
Upgrade your pool to a Fancy Rejuvination Pool. (You need 82 Herblore so it will take a while)
Teleport to Castle Wars via Jewellry Box
Bank All

sections.title: Sailing C — 52 to 62 Sailing and Fallen From Grace

content.text: Route note — Sailing block C: Fallen From Grace unlocks golem crafting, the new alternative to glassblowing for Crafting from 60 to 85, plus Mortimer and the Mad Angel.
Train to 47 Runecraft with a few extra games of Guardians of the Rift
Train to 53 Mining
Train to 62 Sailing
Fallen From Grace needs 62 Sailing, 60 Crafting, 53 Mining and 47 Runecraft (none boostable) and your own raft or skiff, not a sloop
Sail to Wyrmscraig and talk to Cormac in the centre hut of Auchrie to start Fallen From Grace
HCIM: the Mad Angel (level 270) is weak to crush; pray Protect from Melee, stand 2+ tiles behind her for the dust cleave and switch to Protect from Magic for the lightning [Fallen From Grace]
HCIM: you can climb the church pew to escape the Mad Angel at any time [Fallen From Grace]
Complete Fallen From Grace (10,000 Crafting, 12,500 Sailing, 5,000 Mining and 5,000 Runecraft)
Bank anywhere and deposit all
If you are 80 crafting from the gems & battlestaffs then you can immediately skip to the glory steps. Else you may need to craft a bit & sending 85 for a fury instantly which isn’t a bad idea.
NEW option: after Fallen From Grace you can train Crafting with golem crafting (bring hunter furs) instead of Superglass Make glassblowing; pick one method
Withdraw: Pickaxe, Varrock Armour 2, Desert Robe Bottom & Boots, Camulet, Knife, Teak Log, Astral, Fire, Water Runes, Rune pouch, 3x Waterskins
Put the Humidify Runes in the Rune Pouch
Camulet
Mine Sandstone and put in the grinder until you have enough for 80 or 85 respectively (your choice; i’d recommend 85 to get it out of the way)
Buy Empty buckets from Farming shops to withdraw them from the grinder
Withdraw: 3x Giant Seaweed & 18 Sand with Superglass make runes in the Rune Pouch
Use Superglass Make on Lunar spellbook and bank the molten glass. (It is not worth picking surplus glass off the ground so it is recommended to leave it)
Blow the glass into the best option for XP until 80/85 Crafting.

Withdraw: Teleport Runes, Cosmic Runes, games necklace, Cut Dragonstone, Gold Bar, Amulet Mould, Ball of Wool. If 85 Crafting also withdraw Karamja Gloves, Dramen Staff, Chisel, Ball of Wool, Wily Cat, Stews & 29,000 Chaos Runes
Home teleport to Lunar Isle & return to regular Spellbook
Teleport to Falador
Make the Dragonstone Amulet, string it and enchant it
Teleport to Burthorpe and head to the Heroes Guild
Charge the Glory Amulet in the fountain
IF 85 Crafting
Teleport to POH -> BLP
Sell 29,000 Chaos Runes for Tokkul & buy an Onyx (wear the Karamja Gloves so they cost 260,000 Tokkul
Cut the onyx
Use your freshly charged Glory to teleport to Edgeville
Catch rats for Orange Spices for a +5 boost crafting boost
When you get it, teleport to Edgeville and make the Onyx Amulet of the Furnace
String the Amulet & enchant it for Amulet of Fury
Bank at Edgeville Bank
If you haven’t got 44 RuneCraft go to Guardians of the Rift and get this level quickly (This level varies on Sulphua Nagua drops)
Complete the Karamja Hard Diary
Use Lamp on Herblore
Wield the Karamja Gloves & teleport to Gem Mine
Bank at Shilo Village
Withdraw: Teak Logs, Knife, Adamant Pickaxe, Chisel, Karamja Gloves 3, amulet of glory
Make sure your amulet of glory has 1 charge minimum
Teleport on your Karamja Gloves
Mine Gem Rocks for Opals: Expeditious Bracelets, Jades: Amulet of Chemistry, Topaz: Slaughter Bracelets
Get around 30 Topaz, 100 Opals and 50 Jades
Minigame Teleport to Blast Furnace
Buy and smelt 150+ Silver Bars
Teleport to Falador and make all Opals into Expeditious Bracelets, Jades into Amulets of Chemistry, Topaz into Slaughter Bracelets
Buy Balls of Wool at Ardougne if needed
Use the Amulets of Chemistry on your Alchemist’s Amulet
Use Remaining Herbs to 76+ Herblore
Make some Divine Super Strength Potions & Divine Magic Potions (if under 94 magic)
If you reach 76, use a brown spice +5 boost to make Saradomin Brews. If 77, use a Golovanova Pie
Inferno

Complete the Inferno (This depends how versed you are with The Inferno with a Bowfa and no blowpipe etc. Otherwise do the Inferno whenever you feel comfortable to doing it. The guide won’t mention when to, but this is when I did mine.
Withdraw: Air Staff, Law Runes, Earth Runes, Coins, Noted Soft Clay
Teleport to POH and make house tabs with all the soft clay from Perilous Moons. Talk to Demon Butler when there are 3 clay left in your inventory for correct timing.

Here we are going to start setting up the Slayer blocklist. The meta of Slayer these days is to ignore Slayer points entirely outside of buying items and Turael/Aya skip with a blocklist that consists of Turael tasks and not higher slayer masters (once the slayer update comes you can have both block lists which will be very OP)
Block these tasks asap: Dogs (DLQ), Lizards (CIR), Wolves (Stronghold of Security), Kalphites (Task-Only Kalphite Lair), Banshees (CKS)
Order of points usage: Bigger & Badder, Blocking Tasks, Slayer Helmet, Ring Bling, Broad Arrows
If you can buy all of the above through boosting before 69 Slayer then stack as many points as possible doing the same method until 69
Withdraw: Bow of Faerdhinen, Crystal Armour & combat gear.
Complete Monkey Madness 2 (Glough is easy with Bow of Faerdhinen but I would still advise the safe spots)
Complete Path of Glouphrie (easy)
Continue & Complete Defender of Varrock (easy)

Complete While Guthix Sleeps (If you’re worried about Praying the Assassins at the start of the Quest wrong, camp prayer melee (or click prayer melee when the 0 hitsplat from range appears). During the Elemental Boss Fight focus your prayers before gear as he attacks faster and hits harder towards the end of the fight. The Tormented Demons are easy
Buy an Isafdor Painting from Ser Renitee
Complete In Aid of Myreque (All the items should be in the bank except for the mackeral/axes &/or snails & maybe the bars if you used them all)
Complete a Hard Temple Trek [Morytania Hard Diary]
Withdraw: Combat Gear (Bow of Faerdhinen), Pickaxe, Dramen Staff, Teleport Runes, Slayer Helmet, Spade, Ectophial, Silver Bar, Pot, Restore Potion (3), Garlic, Elf Teleport Crystal
Teleport to POH -> BIP
Enter the Nature Grotto & pray piety on the Altar [Morytania Hard Diary]
Head to the Haunted Mine
Mine a Mithril Deposit [Morytania Hard Diary]
Teleport to POH -> Kharyrll Portal [Morytania Hard Diary]
Head to the Slayer Tower and climb both of the Spike climbs [Morytania Hard Diary]
Ectophial
Crush the Silver Bar
Use the Garlic on the Restore Potion, then the crushed Silver to make a Guthix Balanace [Morytania Medium Diary]
Enter Port Phasmatys
Take boat to Mos Le’Harmless
Talk to Brother Tranquility to travel to Harmony Island
Harvest Watermelons
Teleport POH -> CKS
Talk to Le Sabre and complete Morytania Medium & Hard Diary
Teleport to Lletya
Kill an elf with a crystal bow using your Bow of Faerdhinen [Western Province Hard Diary]
Check Health on Palm Tree [Western Province Hard Diary]
Teleport POH -> DLQ
Kill a Dust Devil wearing the Slayer Helmet [Desert Hard Diary]
Bank at Shantay Pass
Withdraw: Combat Gear to kill Kalphite Queen, 2x Ropes, Antipoison, Thralls, etc
Head West to Kalphite Lair
Use Rope to Enter and peak at the end for a free world
Complete Desert Hard Diary at Jarr (Lamp on Herblore)

Withdraw: Combat Gear, Coins, Teleport Runes, 1 Astral Rune, 1 Mind Rune, 1 Cosmic Rune, Sapphire Lantern, Dramen Staff, Adamantite Ore, 6x Coal, Book of the dead, Pickaxe, Seed Dibber, Lockpick, Rada’s Blessing (2), House Teleport (22 Inventory Slots)
Teleport to POH
Change Spellbook to Lunars on Occult Altar
Teleport to Kourend Woodland
Take the Minecart to Mount Quidamortem
Cast Monster Examine on a Troll [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to Lovakenj with Book of the Dead
Mine a Lovakite Ore [Kourend Hard Diary]
Run to the Forgotten Tower
Smelt an Adamant Bar [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to Piscarillius with Book of the Dead
Deliver an Artefact to Captain Khaled [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to Hosidius with Book of the Dead
Plant a Logavano Seed at the Tithe Farm [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to Hosidius again
Enter the Woodcut Guild [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to Shayzien
Head South
Kill a Zombie in the Shayzien Crypts [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to Shayzien
Head North then East
Kill Soldiers from (Tier 1) -> (Tier 5). Drop the obsolete sets when upgraded
House Tab to POH
Change back to Regular Spellbook
Fairy ring -> DJR
Bank at Shayzien Chest
Withdraw: Bow of Fardhinen, Full Crystal, Shayzien Armour 5 (all pieces), Teleport Runes, Antipoison, few food & potions, Dramen Staff
Head North and kill a Lizardmen until you get a Xerics Talisman Drop. Take all Fangs. Wear the Crystal
Head West and kill 1 Lizardman Shaman (Wear the Shayzien armour. You can just stand still by a wall if you want you only need 1 kill) [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to POH -> CIR
Head to Mount Karuulm
Buy Brimstone boots and kill 1 Wyrm [Kourend Hard Diary]
Teleport to Xerics Heart on Xerics Talisman [Kourend Hard Diary]
Talk to Tyss to complete Kourend Hard Diary (Lamp on Herblore)
Now we have the Bone Crusher, Ash Sanctifier & Soul Bearer we can begin the slayer grind towards Raids. This is where we can detour towards the Noxious Halberd if you did not get the Blade of Saeldor
Slayer Grind

Similar to before we are going to be Turael skipping but now that we have hopefully bought everything, slayer points are no longer needed & instead of doing a task every 50th, we can do a task every time we get assigned a good one.
Use the occult altar in your POH to easily swap between Lunars, Arceus & Ancient Spellbook
Astral Contact Duradel for a task. The only tasks you are looking for are
Ankou (Barrage in Catacombs, no alt needed)
Bloodvelds (Barrage with Alts in Catacombs or Saeldor them. Extend if barraging)
Dagannoth (Barrage with Alts in Catacombats or Saeldor them)
Black Demons (Demonic Gorillas with Saeldor & Bow of Faerdhinen (Arclight/Zombie Axe if no Blade))
Greater Demons (Tormented Demons with Dark Demonbane (Ahrim Staff or Blue Moon staff) and Arclight))
Dust Devils (Ice Barrage in Catacombs. Extend ASAP)
Nechryaeel (Ice Barrage in Catacombs. Extend Asap)

Drops wise we are ideally after 4 Zenyte Shards & 3 Tormented Synapses. On drop rate and including all other tasks, we will probably see 87 Slayer at this point. Continue to 92 if you are rushing Noxious Halberd. Once you have all 4 Zenytes & 3 Tormented Synapses we can leave slayer for a while.
Zenyte Order: Anguish -> Suffering -> Tormented Bracelet -> Torture Amulet
Tormented Synapse Order: Purging Staff -> Scorching Bow -> Emberlight (Revert the Purging Staff to Scorching Bow when your Arclight has 0 charges)

NEW slayer master Mortimer (70 Slayer and 100 combat, after Fallen From Grace): you pick one of two tasks with superior monsters, but skips cost 100 points and Turael resets do not work, so keep using Duradel while you skip tasks
If you obtain 87 Slayer, the trident is optional depending if you plan to kill Doom of Mokhaiotl for Eye of Ayak (very dangerous for HCIM for accessable)
If you skipped Blade of Saeldor you can get Kraken Whip which is decent before Nox Hally.
Withdraw: Combat Gear (Blood Moon with Dual Macahuitl’s are best), Coins, Teleport Runes, Dramen Staff, Costume Needle, Hammer, 2x Box Traps, Potions & Food
Teleport to Civitas Illa Fortis
Head to the building North-East of the Quetzals
Inspect Empty Display Case (1) [Ethically Acquired Antiques]
Continue Ethically Acquired Antiques until repairing the Sail
Head South and talk to Emelio (1) [Meat and Greet]
Head back to the Trader Crewmember
Continue Ethically Acquired Antiques until shaming Haig Halen [Ethically Acquired Antiques]
Teleport to Civitas Illa Fortis
Head South & talk to Spice Merchant (2) [Meat and Greet]
Open the box code 2546
AJP Fairy Ring
Head South-West & talk to Guildmaster Fox[At First Light]
Continue At First Light until you need to head to Atza
Head North-West to Ortus Farm
Talk to Alba [Meat and Greet]
Continue Meat and Greet until you need to return to Emilio
Teleport to Civitis Illa Fortis
Head to the building North-East of the Quetzals
Talk to Curator Herminius to complete Ethically Acquired Antiques (4)
Head South-East back to Emelio
Continue & Complete Meat and Greet
Head West
Talk to Atza [At First Light]
Continue At First Light until needing to go to Guildmaster Fox
AJP Fairy Ring
Continue & Complete At First Light
Teleport to Civitas Illa Fortis
Take the Quetzal to Quetzacalli Gorge
Continue & Complete The Heart of Darkness
Make sure to unlock the statue teleport while there
Talk to Servius (1) [The Final Dawn]
Take the Quetzal to Quetzacalli Gorge
Bank all
Withdraw: Blood Moon & Dual Macahuitl’s, combat potions & food
Kill Frost Nagua’s until you get Pendant of Ates (OPTIONAL: Glacial Temotli’s)
Recommended: Kill Amoxiatl instead for the combat achievements; You may get it here passively. The 30 second one you may want to return for
Once you get it, continue The Final Dawn until needing after killing the Emissary
Teleport to Civitas Illa Fortis
Kill a guard & pick up the bones
Continue The Final Dawn until needing to talk to Servius
Bank at Cam Torum
Withdraw: Combat Gear, Food & Potions
Talk to Servius [The Final Dawn]
Continue The Final Dawn until you talk to Attala after killing Lucius & Chimalli
Teleport to Civitas Illa Fortis
Take the Quetzal to Tal Teklan
Talk to Servius [The Final Dawn]
Bank North
Withdraw: Combat Gear, Antifire Shield, Dramen Staff, Saw, 2x plank, Food & Potions
Head North & talk to Alan (1,1) [Scrambled!]
Complete Scrambled!
Fairy Ring -> AIS
Head North over the bridge & bank
Withdraw: Combat Gear, Axe, Knife, 4x Willow Longbow, 5x Maple Logs, 4x Maple Longbow (u), Fishing Rod, Hammer
Head West to the pub
Check Noticeboard (1) [Shadows of Custodia]
Talk to Marcus [Shadows of Custodia]
Talk to Bartender [Shadows of Custodia]
Head North-West
Talk to Ranulph [Vale Totems]
Complete Vale Totems

OPTIONAL: When training crafting you can build the 2 totems East & South-West of the bank and rebuild these for passivish Fletching Experience while bank standing Crafting. Fletch the unstrung bows on the way to them
Head North-East
Talk to Ictus [Shadows of Custodia]
Complete Shadows of Custodia]
Bank North-East
Withdraw: Combat Gear (Melee & Range), Food & Potions, Teleport Runes
Take North Quetzal to Teklan
Continue the Final Dawn until you unlock the Shortcut
Take the shortcut to the surface
Run East & activate statue
Run West & restock food & potions at the bank
Return to the shortcut & descend
Continue & Complete The Final Dawn
Calculate your crafting supplies required via molten glass to obtain 87/90/93 respectively (87 is for Zulrah, 90 Yama, 93 not too important)
Withdraw: Adamant Pickaxe, Knife, Teak Log, 1Mil Coins, Camulet, 3x waterskin, Humidify Runes
Teleport to POH -> Lunar Spellbook
Camulet to inside. Upgrade to infinite charges then camulet outside
Mine however many sand your calculations have shown
Superglass make all the Molten Glass with Giant Seaweed
Blow all the glass until whatever level you are after (I’d recommend 87 minimum for Zulrah or push 90 for Yama)
